batting.dismissal: c VR Aaron b YS Chahal

batting.name: UBT Chand
batting.dismissal: c V Kohli b YS Chahal

batting.dismissal: c YS Chahal b D Wiese

batting.dismissal: c YS Chahal b D Wiese

batting.dismissal: c AT Rayudu b MJ McClenaghan

batting.name: AB de Villiers
batting.dismissal: c KA Pollard b JJ Bumrah

balls.text: run out on the last ball as Harbhajan drives the last ball straight to cover, AB throws the ball to the bowler and there's no way Bhajji can get there
low full toss now outside off, pushed down to long off for one
no, no, don't bowl to him there. It was a full toss on the pads, what else can happen to that? Hammered to the leg side for six
right in the block hole and he blocks it back
dropped at long on by Kohli! A mistimed pulled went high in the air down the ground, Kohli was at least a couple of feet inside the rope but jumped for the catch and put it down
too wide this time outside off, he swings and misses and it's a wide. 200 comes up
second ball of his IPL and he tonks the ball over midwicket for a massive six. Right in the zone and smashed
angled in towards middle and leg, flicked to the midwicket region for one

the most bizarre things are happening here, Wiese gets his third wicket of the over! It was a slower bouncer outside off, Rohit got into position early to pull it to leg, but it stopped on him and he played a slow slap back to the bowler. Wiese took the catch with his right hand
comes down the track and drives that one through the cover boundary right in the gap for four
slightly similar, slightly different, same result in similar fashion! Back of length ball coming in, lofted to the leg side and Chahal runs in this time to catch it easily

Chahal has taken a very good catch at deep midwicket, Pollard is gone. He saw the short of length delivery and played a half-flick-half-pull to the leg side, and Chahal had to jump in the deep to catch it over his head
fullish and angled in towards the pads, Pollard flicks the ball in the air pretty wide of AB at long on for four
flat delivery towards middle stump, turned to the leg side for one
slightly short outside off, punched down to long off
can't clear the fielder this time and finds long off! Swept the fullish ball straight down the ground, not quite from the middle, and holed out to Kohli
plays an inside out drive into the covers for one
turning away again, guides it late to short third man for one
poor delivery and that goes for four too! Short ball turning away and Chand cuts it off the back foot to the point boundary
hooked and the top edge goes for another six! Short ball banged in, he didn't get the middle but got enough to clear fine leg on this short ground
what was that? That's gone all the way - that's timing for you from Rohit. It was fullish outside off, he went down on a knee and just flicked his wrists to clear deep midwicket. Effortless
full and straight on middle, punched down to long off for one
full on off, driven down to long on for one
short of length outside off, there's some room and he cuts it late enough to beat Gayle in the circle at short third man for four
hammered out of the park! Full toss around waist height, pulled clear of the midwicket boundary for a massive six
fourth four of the over and that's Chand's fifty too! Clever shot as Wiese pitched it up and outside off, Chand merely stuck his bat out to find the gap between short third man and point for four
slower bouncer at 115kph outside off, left alone and that's called a wide
slower ball again, at 111kph, it's fullish outside off and pushed down to long on for one
fullish outside off, smashed down to long off for one
three in a row! Slower ball towards leg, Chand waits for it and guides it late fine down the leg side for four more
short ball on the stumps now, he pivots on the back foot and pulls it over the fielder at the edge of the circle and wide of deep square leg for four more
slower ball just outside off, there's no slip and Chand cuts it late to beat the keeper and the third man fielder for a smart four
bit too full outside off, Rohit swings his arms for a lofted and elegant drive to the cover boundary, and that just clears the boundary for a six
swing and a miss as the ball moves away from outside off, he chases and misses
short ball around chest height, Rohit finds the gap by pivoting on the back foot and sending it to the fine leg boundary
back of length outside off, he guides it to point, from where AB tries a direct hit at keeper's end and concedes overthrows
on length now outside off, driven into the covers
back of length towards the body, he tries to swat it to leg but takes it on the body
fullish outside off and it's driven firmly to long off with a straight bat
tries to hammer it to leg, but gets an edge back to the bowler
pushes the ball off the back foot to cover

the danger man is gone off the top edge, the crowd is happy. red flags are waving! He shuffled across a long way to off, swept the length delivery against the turn and got a top edge high in the air behind the keeper fine on leg. Aaron went to his right from short fine leg to take it nicely
heaves the away-turning ball to leg from outside off but misses
flatter outside off, Simmons knows about the gap there and cuts it fiercely off the back foot to send it rolling between short third man and point for four
turns it away from well outside off, another wide as it's left alone
Chand on fire now! Gets a full delivery on middle and leg, and slog-sweeps it to the cow corner for a massive six. The ball lands in the middle of a big crowd
slightly flat on middle stump, he goes back and turns it towards midwicket for one
full on the pads and it's driven down to long on for one
flattish wide way outside off, deflects off the gloves of the keeper for another run

appeal for lbw, Abdulla looks more confident than DK, though! Chand tried the flick the ball down leg but missed, and the momentum took him out of the crease. His left foot is grounded when the bails are taken off, not out
flighted full toss is tonked down the ground, it falls just before long on
tries the slog sweep on the leg side, gets inside egde on the pads
that's high in the air on off and falls safe! He went down on a knee to loft the ball with a drive, it landed right in between sweeper cover and long off safely
takes a step down and and tucks the length delivery to long on for one more
shorter and flatter on off, he rocks back pulls along the ground to midwicket, that's the team's 100
leans forward and blocks the length delivery to cover
pretty full on middle and leg, pushed down to long on and he gets his fifty, off 36 balls
slower through the air just outside off, guides it late to third man
fullish on middle and leg, sweeps and gets an inside edge to short fine leg
not much power this time, he uses the pace of the ball to steer the fullish delivery on the leg side to fine leg for four
slightly full around off and it's pushed down gently to mid off
short of length outside off, there's room and Simmons makes some room to cut it nicely past point for four
crackalicious, that's hit the roof! Short ball, he picked it up and absolutely tonked it to the midwicket boundary roof for six!
charges down this time with some room, can't clear cover as he doesn't middle it
short ball just outside off, Simmons defends with a horizontal bat and nearly loses his balance
flighted and full on middle, pushed back to the bowler
comes down this time and defends the length delivery towards cover
was that too short, didn't look like. Chand just went back and pounced on it to pull it over the midwicket boundary for a massive six
fuller on middle and turning to off, defends off the back foot to point
on off now, Chand makes room again and cuts dangerously to point this time
cracking four! Short and flat outside off, turning it away and Chand cut it fiercely through the point boundary
shuffles to off, Abdulla pitches it full and close to him, pushed to cover
chases a full and wide delivery well outside off and misses
charges down and launches it for six! He took it on the full from middle and leg and cleared the long on boundary
too much on the leg side and he easily sweeps it to deep fine leg for one
tossed up outside off, driven down to long off for one
makes some room, Abdulla pitches that on the pads and it's flicked to deep midwicket for one
presses forward and drives the length ball straight to point
third slower ball in a row, but this one on the pads and it's driven to leg for one
slower again, and a touch shorter, Simmons waits and guides it to third man for one
slower ball cutting in from outside off, he defends it late on off but there's no time for one
on off and wide, driven with a forward lean to sweeper cover for one
fullish on the pads, clipped towards square leg and they come back for the second by the time the fielder comes in from the deep
tossed up on middle and leg, clipped to midwicket for one
that's a mere push off the front foot and it goes for four! Absolutely full outside off, he punched it through the covers and it beat long off and sweeper cover
slog-swept for four! Pitched up on the leg stump, he went down on a knee and struck that one wide of deep midwicket
leans forward and drives the fullish delivery from outside off behind square in the gap for two
on length on middle and off, pushes it into the covers off the front foot
touch short on middle, punched off the back foot to cover

goes to the third umpire first ball! He clipped the fullish delivery on the pads towards mid on, the alert fielder got a direct hit at non-striker's end as Chand didn't quite drag his bat in, but he was well inside. Off the mark

the slower ball does it, PP is gone, Chinnaswamy erupts! Wiese bowled a slower one at 115kph, on middle and off, Parthiv defended on the off side but played the wrong line and got an inside edge onto the stumps
touch wider outside off, Simmons drives it a bit late to third man for one
135kph, accurate length delivery just outside off, Simmons defends solidly to cover
bit of swing towards the pads, tucked towards square leg for a leg bye
almost in the block hole outside off, PP blocks it back
frees his arms on the off side now. It was too full and had room, Simmons opened up and cleared point with a powerful drive along the ground
heaves on the leg side, doesn't get the middle of it but gets enough to find the gap between mid on and midwicket for four
fuller and outside off, driven firmly and straight to AB at cover
bit too much on the leg side and it's deflected off the pads for a single
swings it in towards the pads, no room and PP defends it towards midwicket
bit of room outside off, driven firmly to Kohli short point who has a shy at the non-striker's stumps
goes through short fine leg for four! Simmons went back in the crease for the ball that was angled in, it went fine down leg, the fielder tried to stop it by rolling to his right but couldn't
back of length and shaping away, punched off the back foot to extra cover
on the other side now - short again, Simmons went back and swiveled it pull it to midwicket for a one-bounce four
cracking shot! Cleared his front foot again, smacked the short and away-going delivery just wide of third man through the air!
angled in this time towards the pads, it deflects down towards the keeper and PP says no for the single
clears his front foot to smack it, Aaron pitches it short and swings it away to beat Simmons. That's harshly called a wide
straight length delivery on off stump, pushed down to mid on
accurate delivery on off stump with some outswing, inside edge goes towards short fine leg, they scamper for one and make it
fullish outside off, pushed to cover point off the front foot for a quick single
loud appeal for lbw, this one swung in after pitching on middle and leg, hint of swing as it beat Parthiv's bat to hit him right in front of leg. Looked out to me
length delivery just outside off, pushed down to mid off
bit too short, Parthiv rocks back and pulls it to the midwicket boundary for four more
starts on the off stump and Parthiv goes back a bit to turn it on the leg side by closing the face of the bat, it races away wide of mid on. Nicely timed
hint of outswing for the length delivery outside off, left alone
too short this time and Simmons hammers it to the leg side with a pull through the air. Cracking sound from the middle of the bat
quick and straight at 147kph just outside off, Simmons lets it go
short of length around off, Simmons goes back to pull but gets a bottom edge to leg
quick at 148kph, swings it in towards Parthiv' waist, he takes it on the body and takes a quick single
swings it again down leg, this was a full toss and it swung so much that even DK couldn't get to it. Five wide
starts with a swinging delivery down the leg side
on length just outside off, punched down to mid-off off the back foot, clean and tidy over
angled in towards the pads this time, steered to short fine leg
flatter and shorter on off stump, he waits and guides it to point
presses forward a bit and pushes the length delivery to cover
fullish on the pads, tucked behind square on the leg side for another
flighted outside off, Simmons pushes it down to mid off off the front foot for one
that's a four to finish the chase as he guided that full delivery from outside off between point and short third man
full around off, lofted down the ground and Rohit cuts it off while going to his left
takes the pace off again and targets the stumps, slogged to the leg side for one
another slower short ball, pulls this time and finds deep backward square leg
slower short ball, he heaves and misses that one

dropped at long-on by Rohit! Wiese waited for the slower ball and lofted it down the ground, Rohit had enough time to take a few steps in but he spills it. At least he throws it quickly and Abdulla can't come back on time
makes room again, Malinga chases him with a very low full toss which is pushed to cover
almost a yorker just outside off, Abdulla makes room and looks to drive on off, and gets a thick edge fine on off for four

full on off, driven down to long on. There's a confusion as they think of two. Wiese turns around for the second but is sent back. Malinga doesn't collect the ball which makes Abdulla think of overthrows but Wiese is flat on the ground
nearly in the block hole again on off stump, punched back to Malinga
right in the block hole again under pressure, Wiese blocks it back. He had no choice
yorker at 138kph on the off stump, digs it out towards point for one
starts with a wide down the leg side
fullish on the pads now, flicked away to deep midwicket for one
that's a bouncer, Abdulla hooks and misses. Called a no ball for the second bouncer of the over. The bowler is very unhappy
full toss on the pads, that's nearly a four but deep backward square leg takes it on the bounce and saves three
too short to mix up the length, it was a slower one and Wiese cuts it fiercely wide of point
that's poor length - too full outside off and Wiese hammers it through the covers for another four
clever slower bouncer outside off, Wiese waits, then looks to cut but misses
short of length and wide outside off, he slices it off the back foot and finds the gap between point and short third man for four
full again, room outside off and this one's driven through the covers in the air for another four in the gap
straight down the ground over the umpire's head who's flat on the ground! Abdulla made room and charged down, Chand put in a dive after running from long on but could not cut it in
angled into the batsman, Wiese makes use of it by flicking it high in the air over fine leg for six
attempted yorker on middle stump, pushed down to long on for one
slower one at 103kph outside off, flicked on the leg side behind square
angles in the ball towards the batsman who swings with a swivel and beats short fine leg for a four. 15 from that over
full again on the pads, tucked to fine leg for one more
pretty full now outside off, drives it down firmly to long off
full toss again, on off, and it's hammered down the ground with to the sight screen for six
low full toss on the pads, flicks it fine to fine leg for one
low full toss down leg, called a wide as the batsman looked to play it fine
length delivery outside off, punched down to long on for one
that's too full outside off and he slams it over the covers with a big swing for four
swing and a miss! Short ball angling across, he looks to cut and misses
outside off this time, he looks to push it down but manages only an inside edge towards short cover
back of length ball from outside leg towards the stumps, tucked to midwicket
AB holes out, that's pretty much the end for RCB! full delivery on the stumps, AB put his back foot in the crease and tonked it straight down to Pollard at long-on
angled in sharply from back of length outside off, inside edge hits the pad and they sneak in a single
waits for the ball that pitches outside off and cuts it to deep point for one
goes back in the crease and tucks it to midwicket
goes on the back foot and punches it back to the bowler
shuffles back and across, this one's towards the leg and he deflects it late and fine down the leg side to beat short third man for four
goes back and defends the length ball to leg
first-ball duck for Rilee Rossouw! Harbhajan came round the wicket and angled this one in, looked like Rossouw played for the straighter one but it came in and disturbed the stumps
and another, AB's on fire! Full and wide outside off, AB swung his arms with a big follow through and beats the cover fielder for a racing boundary
it's a four but Malinga is smiling! Length delivery outside off, AB tries to reverse lap it over short third man but the ball goes off the edge over the keeper on the leg side
yorker right on the leg stump, AB steers it to leg and hares back for the second
116kph, the sweet sound of AB's bat tonking the ball! Short of length outside off, he stayed back and heaved it to the midwicket boundary roof. Nobody had to move, how he hits these so cleanly
it's full, so it's in AB's zone and he launches it high in the air on the off side. Not sure if he middled that but it crossed the cover boundary for six

chipped in the air and Chand takes a very good catch running in from mid off, Malinga gets a breakthrough! It was fullish on off, DK looked to play it down the ground but played it early and the ball lobbed towards mid-off. Chand ran in and dived forward to get his fingers under it
sow and down leg as the batsman tries to heave it. It's a wide and the keeper can't hold on to it so they run one too
short ball now, maybe he was expecting that so he went back in the crease and pulled it with power over square leg for six. Goes in the crowd on its feet
pretty wide outside off, that's called a wide. Pressure to change line and length
laps it over short fine leg for four! Went down and across well outside off, took the ball as a low full toss and scooped it high to the leg side for four
pretty full outside off, DK plays a lofted cover drive in the air and sweeper cover cuts it to two
almost in the block hole, he steers it to point for one
smashed down the ground, no time for long off to get there! He charges down, doesn't care about the line and length and clobbers it down the ground to the right of long off
some room outside off, driven firmly to sweeper cover for one
that's a clever shot! Short ball angled across outside off, he ramps it softly over the slip region with nobody there and gets another four. He's on 14 off 3. The crowd thinks there's a chance
second-ball six! MM pitched it up, AB launched it down the ground with a lofted straight drive and that went all the way
sloppy work at third man! Slightly wide outside off, AB guided it to third man and Bumrah let that one go through him while running to his right
holes out straight to sweeper cover! Short and wide, there's an opportunity to swing his arms, he does, and finds Rayudu in the deep
slow and full well outside off, Kohli lets it go for a wide
pretty full and wide outside off, he charges down and misses
outside off with the angle, driven to sweeper cover for one
back of length outside off, pulled to the leg side for one
outside off and he guides it straight to short third man

that's how you spell chaos.comedy! It was fullish this time with some room, he drove to sweeper cover for two. Both batsmen were running down the same side of the pitch, on the leg side, and then kept runnng diagonally to collide. Sure shot run-out chance but Pandya doesn't collect the quick throw
takes a step down, short of length ball outside off with hardly any room and he defends it back
towards the stumps now, pushed down to the left of midwicket for a quick single
charges down first ball, Pandya pitches it outside off, Kohli swings ans misses
takes a step down and drives it through the covers
pitches it up, Kohli gets under it and tonks it to the wide long on boundary for a massive six right from the middle of the bat
comes down the track and drives it back to the bowler from outside off
darts it straight outside off, Kohli pushes it back
length delivery on leg, tucks it towards midwicket for one
two catches dropped, he's bowled this time! Gayle charged down the track, Bhajji delivered this one in towards off and middle from outside off. Gayle missed as he slogged and the ball did the rest
takes the pace off the ball and pitches it shorter, Kohli whips it towards deep midwicket for one
he's been dropped again, Malinga this time! Gayle heaved the slower ball on the leg side behind square, Maling went to his right to catch but put it down. It was not a touch chance at all
back of length outside off, guides it to third man by opening the face of the bat
charges down, flicks the ball in the air between long and deep midwicket. He didn't really middle it but it had enough to beat long-on's football skills
slow and full on leg, flicked off the back foot to deep midwicket
bouncer from Bumrah outside off, Gayle lets it go and it's a wide for height this time
angled in from outside off, Kohli guides it late to third man by opening the face of the bat
shuffles back and across towards off, defends the ball towards midwicket for one
much shorter, which gives Gayle time and he pulls it to deep backward square for one
straighter one on the off stump, no room at all and Gayle manages to defend it
goes back in the crease again and steers this one to square leg
slightly flat and outside off, Kohli goes back and defends to midwicket
slightly short of length outside off, swatted off the backfoot on the leg side
shuffles across a bit and defends the length delivery from outside off to point
jabs the wider delivery outside off straight to point
134kph, short ball outside off, gets extra bounce and nearly took Kohli's outside edge as he poked and missed
slow again outside leg, steered to short fine leg and the throw hits Gayle on the way
finally angled across the off stump, Gayle sticks his bat out and misses
somehow gets it on the leg stump, Gayle tucks it towards midwicket where Malinga doesn't bend enough and concedes a second
four in a row - that was not the slower one but was wide. Makes Rohit smile about it in the circle
hat-trick of wides - all down the leg side
similar delivery as it's another slower delivery down leg for a wide
starts with a slow wide down the leg side
bowled him! Bisla makes room for the shortish delivery to cut off the back foot, misses it completely and loses middle stump. Bhajji waves him goodbye mainly moving the tip of his fingers
comes down the track again, Bhajji delivers a yorker and it's blocked back
mid on is in, he charges down and lofts the ball down the ground and over long on boundary for six
dipping, low full toss on middle and leg, pushed down to mid on
shuffles across on a knee again, looks to sweep the ball with the turn but doesn't connect and takes it on the pad
turning in towards middle and leg, he goes down on a knee and sweeps it to the fine-leg boundary for a one-bounce four
120kph, on off and middle, turned towards the midwicket region for one
yet another slower ball, well outside off, Gayle looked to drive, maybe looked to leave it later, and got the toe of the bat towards third man for one
another slower ball, on the middle stump now, and he tucks it to short fine leg for one
slower ball towards the pads, Bisla can't put it away and is sent back by Gayle for the quick single
tries the yorker again, Gaylse swings his bat and gets an inside edge to fine leg
right in the block hole on middle, he digs it out to the leg side
charges down the pitch and looks to hoick it down the ground but gets a thick inside edge to short fine leg
short delivery that sails over Bisla's helmet. Mitch Mc turns back and takes a sheepish look at the umpire, but he is safe this time. No heartbreaking signal from the umpire
moves to the leg side and looks to carve the back of length delivery through off but finds the man at cover
superb timing this time! He stayed put in the crease and whipped the fuller delivery through midwicket with a wristy flick
tries to repeat the shot but goes too far away from the line, misses the line of the ball and is beaten
smashing shot! He moves away to create room, then rides the bounce of the length delivery to punch it beautifully through cover
and third offcutter in a row. Although Gayle gets a bat this time, he has merely pushed it back to the bowler. It's a maiden. Excellent start for Malinga
another slower delivery, this one turns away to beat Gayle's attempted cut shot. Reaches the keeper on the bounce
bowls the cutter and this one grips the surface, turns away from the batsman and reaches the keeper on the bounce
superb yorker this time. Malinga targets his favourite leg stump but Gayle is watchful, digs it out to the leg side
length delivery outside off, still a touch slower from Malinga, Gayle defends it to the off side
starts off with a slower delivery that is dabbed towards midwicket
gets good bounce again from back of length, Bisla defends it to the off side
shuffles across and tucks the back of length delivery through midwicket for a single
he is lucky this time that the umpire didn't call this a wide, it swung away and flew just over the wide marker
back of length and swings away, this is called a wide.. It's turning out to be a rather long over for Mitch Mc here.
walks across to the off side and defends the length delivery to the off side
keeps bouncing him and Gayle misses his pull this time! But this is a harsh call from the umpire.. No wonder Mitch Mc is miffed
he digs this one short, bowls it with a grunt and the umpire calls it a wide after Gayle lets it go

dropped by Simmons at cover! This was short of length and Gayle slapped it straight at the fielder, waist high.. should have been taken. This could turn costly. Too hard on Mitch Mc.. he almost has the big wicket
good bounce first up as the batsman lets it go through, Patel takes it high up. Two slips in place
